_about: TODO-19 stage 1 readout comparison (ReadoutStudy via Gcam.EvidenceProbe readout-* modes). Selection and validation seed lists are disjoint and distinct from every other list (seeds.json _rules_readout). The pilot exercises every metric in minutes and is not evidence; the timing family is one selection seed of the full request. Selection sweeps the DPC column/row resistance ratio (RD-12); validation runs the full matrix on its disjoint seeds (RD-13). Long runs (selection, validation) are started by the planner. The pitch confirmation (turn 5) runs request-confirmation-v1.json on RO_CONFIRMATION32 under the rule pinned in readout/confirmation-pin-v1.json.
